plugins.name: X(Twitter)
plugins.description: An X(Twitter) content parsing plugin for Content Hive. Parses Twitter/X.com status URLs to extract post content, images, videos, and author information via the fxtwitter API.
author: content-hive

plugins.name: 小红书
plugins.description: 适用于 Content Hive 的小红书内容解析插件，通过抓取笔记页面并提取嵌入的页面状态来获取内容。
author: content-hive
plugins.disclaimer: 本插件通过抓取小红书网页获取内容，使用前请确保符合小红书服务条款及当地法律法规。平台规则变更可能导致插件失效。

plugins.name: 抖音
plugins.description: 一个用于Content Hive的抖音内容解析插件。通过解析抖音链接，提取视频内容、作者信息等数据。
author: content-hive
plugins.disclaimer: 本插件通过解析抖音链接获取内容，需要配置账号 Cookie 以访问受保护内容，存在账号被封禁的风险。使用前请确保符合抖音服务条款及当地法律法规，并自行承担相关风险。平台规则变更可能导致插件失效。

plugins.name: 即刻
plugins.description: 适用于 Content Hive 的即刻内容解析插件，支持图文、Live Photo 及视频帖子的内容解析。
author: content-hive

plugins.name: X(Twitter)
plugins.description: An X(Twitter) content parsing plugin for Content Hive. Fetches tweet content, images, videos, and author information via the GraphQL API.
author: content-hive
plugins.disclaimer: This plugin fetches content via X(Twitter) public APIs. Please ensure compliance with X's Terms of Service and applicable local laws before use. Platform policy changes may cause the plugin to stop working.

plugins.name: Instagram
plugins.description: An Instagram content parsing plugin for Content Hive. Fetches post content, images, videos, reels, and author information. Requires authentication via sessionid cookie (private API).
author: content-hive
plugins.disclaimer: This plugin fetches content via Instagram APIs. Please ensure compliance with Instagram's Terms of Service and applicable local laws before use. Platform policy changes may cause the plugin to stop working.

plugins.name: Threads
plugins.description: A Threads content parsing plugin for Content Hive. Parses post URLs to extract text, images, videos, and author information via mobile page scraping. Supports optional cookie authentication for accessing restricted content.
author: content-hive
plugins.disclaimer: This plugin fetches content via Threads mobile page scraping. Cookie authentication may carry the risk of account suspension. Please ensure compliance with Threads' Terms of Service and applicable local laws before use. Platform policy changes may cause the plugin to stop working.
